fields.quote: Importantly, no differences were found between patients with heterozygous Dectin-1 SNP rs16910526 (Y238X, T/G genotype, n=13 patients) and wild type carriers with regard to all analyzed infectious complications.

Importantly, no differences were found between patients with heterozygous Dectin-1 SNP rs16910526 (Y238X, T/G genotype, n=13 patients) and wild type carriers with regard to all analyzed infectious complications.

items.item_note: The paper gives only the heterozygous genotype 'T/G' and does not say which allele is the variant or effect allele. A's assignment of G as effect and T as other is an inference, so B's blanks match what is printed. This is a judgement call.

fields.quote: patients carrying the homozygous Dectin-1 SNP rs7309123 (G/G genotype, n=43 patients) revealed a significantly higher risk for developing both pneumonia in general (p=0.018, odds ratio (OR): 2.46; 95% confidence interval (CI): 1.2 - 4.9) and pulmonary IFD (p=0.023, OR: 2.3; 95% CI: 1.2 - 4.5)
In detail, 24 patients harbouring homozygous Dectin-1 SNP developed pneumonia in general whereas 18 of them fulfilled criteria for IFD.

items.item_note: G/G homozygotes compared against the rest of the cohort corresponds to a recessive model. 18 G/G patients met the criteria for IFD.
